description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' interoperability with F# types and grains, validating serialization and cross-language support for F# constructs such as records, options, and discriminated unions within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: FSharpGrainTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans' support for F# types and serialization.

methods.name: PingTest
methods.description: Generic helper method to test pinging a grain with a specific input and verifying the output.

methods.description: Test for basic generic grain functionality with primitive F# types.
